No-root modes (Shizuku / ADB, including Universal Devices BETA) read frame timestamps from SurfaceFlinger for the app that is currently on screen. FPS therefore appears once you are inside an app or game.

The home screen / launcher, SystemUI, keyboard and wallpaper are intentionally ignored (for example com.android.launcher3, com.miui.home). Over a launcher the overlay shows 0 FPS — this is normal, not a bug.

A static screen also reads 0 FPS: FPS is the number of new frames drawn per second, so a menu or paused screen that does not redraw has none. It goes up as soon as something animates, scrolls or plays.
Shizuku must be running with permission granted. If you restart your phone or Shizuku stops, start it again; FPS resumes by itself after a few seconds.

Root mode and the kernel-node modes (Universal GPU / Adaptive Auto) can read FPS from the display driver instead, but only on devices that expose that node. Games using their own render surface are detected through their SurfaceView layer.

ZKM Next has three working modes: Basic (no privileged access, view-only features), ADB (shell level through Shizuku or wireless debugging, no root) and ROOT (everything unlocked). Kernel tuning, kernel flasher, GPU, thermal and battery controller menus need ROOT. Terminal, SetEdit, debloat, doze, display, compiler, FPS and process tools work from ADB mode. Game Space also works from ADB mode (Game Mode, memory clean, background limiter); its CPU and GPU frequency control needs ROOT. You can change the mode any time in Settings. Special permissions (Usage Access, Display over other apps, notifications) are only requested when you open the related menu.

Every dangerous action shows a confirmation. Still: export your settings from Settings > Backup before heavy tuning, keep a boot-image backup before flashing kernels, and change tuning values one at a time so you always know what caused a problem.

ZKM Next supports runtime language packs: JSON files that override any built-in string. Export the current pack from Settings, translate the values, then import it back. An Indonesian pack for the help system ships with this release. Note: importing a pack replaces all current overrides.

The glass look is intentionally rich, but nothing is wasted: blur styles are cached, icons downscaled and lists keyed. If you still want it lighter, reduce weather intensity, use a static wallpaper instead of video, or pick a static avatar frame - all from Wallpaper & Style Studio and the profile widget.
